exposure: Maximum level of maternal serum total bile acid (TBA)
outcome: Biochemical outcomes (Triglyceride (TG), low density lipoprotein (LDL), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), total bile acid (TBA))
cohort: 724 women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP)
finding: GDM independently contributes to adverse pregnancy outcomes among women with ICP, but the combined effects of GDM and maximum TBA concentration on adverse pregnancy outcomes do not appear to be multiplicative or additive.
